verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs describe sandbox images (templates) built from Dockerfiles. These are customized, reusable environments with pre-configured tools, languages and frameworks, and new sandboxes deploy from them in seconds. That directly covers defining custom templates and bringing your own container definition. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of importing an existing prebuilt image from an external registry, deeper detail on the template build and deploy workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
